readerCopy.body: Existing goodwill can make the next step easier when support has a concrete way to participate. When Venus sextiles the North Node, connection and forward movement cooperate through introductions, recommendations, shared expenses, flexible schedules, housing, or other practical help. Care becomes more useful when the needed form is clear enough to act on. A relationship can materially expand the available options without becoming responsible for choosing the direction.
